steps.title: Subcontract, packaging, freight and commissions
steps.intro: The steps costed on top of materials, labour and overhead, for revision {revision} in colourway {colourway}. A new cost sheet version is written from them.
steps.noSizesBody: The style has no size range yet: give it one on Colourways & sizes.
steps.noGrain: Costs are not in your role: the steps show their lines and quantities, no figure.
steps.cartonHint: Nothing keeps it: type it to cost the carton's share of one garment.
steps.cartonProblem: Type a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
steps.cartonHeld: Type a whole number from 1 to 10,000 first.
steps.cartonSame: The steps are costed with this number already.

empty.subcontract: No step of the routing is done by a workshop.
empty.packaging: No packaging is costed: no default polybag, hanger, box or carton for this style, and no packaging on its bill of materials.
empty.freight: No freight, insurance or duty is set on its materials.
empty.commission: None: commissions are not costed from the components. A version keeps a commission only as a typed line.

steps.versionsNote: These are today's figures. A cost sheet version keeps them as they were when it was written.

stepSource.UPLIFT: Freight, duty or transport set by you
stepSource.LANDED_COST: From the landed cost of earlier receipts

stepLine.freightOnKind: Freight on materials of the kind: {kind}
stepLine.insuranceOnKind: Insurance on materials of the kind: {kind}
stepLine.dutyOnKind: Duty on materials of the kind: {kind}

stepHow.landed: {pct} % of the materials it covers, read from the landed cost of earlier receipts: {amount}.
stepHow.landedNoGrain: {pct} % of the materials it covers, read from the landed cost of earlier receipts.
stepHow.percent: {pct} % of what it is counted on: {amount}.
stepHow.percentNoGrain: {pct} % of what it is counted on.
stepHow.pieceRate: One piece at the operation's published piece rate: {amount}.
stepHow.pieceRateNoGrain: One piece at the operation's published piece rate.
stepHow.carton: The carton's cost divided by {pieces} garments: {amount}.
stepHow.cartonNoGrain: The carton's cost divided by {pieces} garments.

stepMissing.NO_BOM: The revision has no bill of materials.
stepMissing.BOM_QUANTITY: A material line has no quantity for a size.
stepMissing.MATERIAL_UNIT: A material's unit cannot be turned into its base unit.
stepMissing.MATERIAL_PRICE: A material has no standard cost.
stepMissing.MATERIAL_CURRENCY: A material is priced in another currency than the sheet's.
stepMissing.LABOUR_RATE: A department has no labour rate.
stepMissing.LABOUR_CURRENCY: A labour rate is in another currency than the sheet's.
stepMissing.LEATHER_GRADE: A leather's grade mix names a grade without its usable share.
stepMissing.LEATHER_UNIT: A leather's area cannot be turned into the unit it is priced in.
stepMissing.PIECE_RATE_CURRENCY: A piece rate is in another currency than the sheet's.
stepMissing.SUBCONTRACT_FEE: An outside operation has no fee per piece (agreed per order).
stepMissing.SUBCONTRACT_CURRENCY: An outside operation's fee is in euros and the sheet is not.
stepMissing.TRANSPORT_CURRENCY: A workshop's transport is in another currency than the sheet's.
stepMissing.PACKAGING_PRICE: A packaging default has no cost.
stepMissing.CARTON_PIECES: Type the garments per carton to cost the carton's share.
stepMissing.OVERHEAD_FIGURE: An overhead rule per machine hour needs machine hours, which no routing gives yet.
stepMissing.SUB_ASSEMBLY_COST: A sub-assembly cannot be costed for this size.

stepWarn.NO_WRITTEN_TERMS: A workshop has no signed agreement in force: its fee is the routing's.
stepWarn.NO_TRANSPORT: A workshop has no transport set: its trips cost nothing here.
stepWarn.NO_PIECE_RATE: Piece-rate labour is on, but an operation has no piece rate in every size: it is costed by its minutes.
stepWarn.PIECE_RATE_SITE: Piece-rate labour is on, but the site paying piece rates is not clear: the labour is costed by its minutes.
stepWarn.PACKAGING_TWICE: Packaging is both on the bill of materials and in the packaging defaults: it may be counted twice.
stepWarn.OVERHEAD_TWICE: A labour rate already carries overhead a minute and an overhead rule a minute adds more: overhead may be counted twice.
stepWarn.NO_LEATHER_BASIS: A leather has no cost basis (yield and grade mix): its area is the bill of materials' with its wastage.

ver.title: Cost sheet versions and approval
ver.intro: Draft, approved and frozen cost sheets per season. Prices are released from an approved version; an approved version is locked, and a change is a new version.
ver.failed: Couldn't read the cost sheet versions
ver.compareHeld: Two versions are needed to compare.
ver.noGrain: Costs are not in your role: the versions show their state and season, no figure.
ver.emptyBody: Write the first one from the components of revision {revision}.
ver.emptyNoRevision: The style has no revision to cost yet.
ver.name: Version {version}

verWords.draft: A draft: its target may change. Send it for approval to lock it; the person who approves is never the one who asked or made it.
verWords.waiting: Waiting for the costing owner's approval. Changing or deleting the draft withdraws the request.
verWords.approved: Approved and locked: quotes and price lists take its target price. A change is a new version.
verWords.superseded: Frozen: a later version was approved in its place. It stays as it was.
verWords.seasonClosed: Frozen when its season closed. It stays as it was.
verWords.withdrawn: Taken back by the costing owner: no version of its series is approved until a new one is.

verView.title: Version {version}
verView.baseUnknown: An input is missing at the base size
verView.weighted: Weighted cost for a typical size mix
verView.lockedWhat: To change it, copy it as a new version: the copy starts as a draft.
verView.weightsMissing: Not known while sizes {sizes} miss an input
verView.noMix: No size mix: give the style its typical sizes to get a weighted cost.
verView.leftOut_one: {count} input was left out when it was written
verView.leftOut_other: {count} inputs were left out when it was written

weightSource.KEPT: The size mix kept when this version was written.
weightSource.SEASON: The size mix is the style's own for this season.
weightSource.EVERY_SEASON: The size mix is the style's own for every season.
weightSource.SIZE_CURVE: The size mix is the size curve's.
weightSource.NONE: No size mix was kept on this version.

verHeld.noManage: Not in your role: writing cost sheets needs costing.sheets.manage.
verHeld.noRevision: The style has no revision to cost.
verHeld.busy: Wait for the change in progress.
verHeld.notDraft: Only a draft can do this.
verHeld.waiting: It is already waiting for approval.
verHeld.noLines: It has no line to approve.
verHeld.seasonClosed: Its season is closed: write a version for an open season.
verHeld.cannotSubmit: It cannot be sent now: an input it left out is not covered.
verHeld.noDecide: Not in your role: deciding approvals needs approvals.decide.
verHeld.ownRequest: You asked for it: another person approves it.
verHeld.notTheApprover: The request waits for someone else: you are not its approver, or you made this version.
verHeld.noApprove: Not in your role: taking an approved version back needs costing.sheets.approve.
verHeld.notApproved: Only an approved version can be taken back.
verHeld.copiedFrom: Another version was copied from it: it stays.
verHeld.locked: An approved or frozen version is locked: copy it as a new version to change its target.
verHeld.noPriceGrain: Prices are not in your role.

read.unavailable: The factory can't be reached. Try again in a moment.
read.notFound: It is not there any more.
read.invalid: The request was refused as it is.

write.unavailable: Not saved: the factory can't be reached. Try again in a moment.
write.moved: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again. Look and try again.
write.forbidden: Not saved: not in your role.
write.stepUp: Not saved: a fresh authenticator code is needed.
write.notFound: It is not there any more: the list was read again.
write.invalid: Not saved: a value was refused. Look at the fields and try again.

verRefusal.LOCKED: An approved version is locked: a change is a new version.
verRefusal.NOT_APPROVED: Only an approved version can be taken back.
verRefusal.NO_LINES: A version without lines cannot be sent for approval.
verRefusal.LEFT_OUT: Inputs were left out when it was written: tick that typed lines cover them, or write a new version once they are there.
verRefusal.SEASON_CLOSED: Its season is closed: write a version for an open season.
verRefusal.OWN_SHEET: You made this version: another person approves it.
verRefusal.NO_APPROVER: No one else can approve it: a role with costing.sheets.approve and approvals.decide needs a person other than you.
verRefusal.OTHER_SERIES: A copy stays in the same series (company and season): write a new version from the components instead.
verRefusal.OTHER_REVISION: A copy keeps its revision: write a version of another revision from its components.
verRefusal.COPIED_FROM: Another version was copied from this draft: it stays.
verRefusal.BASE_SIZE: The base size is not a size of the style.
verRefusal.NOTHING_CHANGES: Nothing changes: every value is the one it has.
verRefusal.OTHER_STYLE: The two versions belong to different styles.
verRefusal.OTHER_CURRENCY: The two versions are in different currencies.
verRefusal.NO_COMPANY: A cost sheet is costed for one company: open the style in its company.
verRefusal.INCOMPLETE: Inputs are missing: tick "Leave the missing inputs out" to write it anyway, or fill them in first.
verRefusal.NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft takes new lines.
verRefusal.DATABASE: Another change was made at the same time: it was read again. Look and try again.

verStepUp.title: Confirm it's you
verStepUp.sentence: An approval rule asks for a fresh code to approve this cost sheet.

problem.wrong: That code didn't work. Type the code your authenticator shows now.
problem.locked: Too many tries: wait a minute and try again.
problem.unavailable: The code couldn't be checked. Try again in a moment.

verNew.title: New version from revision {revision}
verNew.copyTitle: Copy version {version} as a new version
verNew.intro: Written from the components of the revision today: materials, leather, labour, overhead, subcontract, packaging, freight and duties.
verNew.copyIntro: The copy keeps the version's lines, revision and season, and starts as a draft.
verNew.seasonHint: An open season of the company, or none.
verNew.baseSizeHint: The size its cost is read at.
verNew.targetPriceHint: Optional: the price quotes start from once it is approved.
verNew.leaveOutHint: The version lists what was left out; it can be approved only when typed lines cover it.

problem.pieces: Type a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
problem.price: Type a figure above 0, with at most 6 decimals.
problem.margin: Type a percent below 100, with at most 4 decimals.

verSend.title: Send version {version} for approval
verSend.intro: The costing owner approves it; it is then locked. Whoever made or sends it never approves it.
verSend.leftOut_one: {count} input was left out when it was written.
verSend.leftOut_other: {count} inputs were left out when it was written.
verSend.leftOutHeld_one: Tick that typed lines cover the {count} input left out.
verSend.leftOutHeld_other: Tick that typed lines cover the {count} inputs left out.
verSend.covered: Typed lines on this version cover what was left out

verApprove.title: Approve and lock version {version}
verApprove.intro: You approve the version as it stands now:
verApprove.after: Once approved it is locked: quotes and price lists take its target price, and the version approved before it is frozen.

verBack.title: Take back version {version}
verBack.intro: The version is frozen and its series has no approved version until a new one is approved. Quotes go back to the revision's cost.

problem.short: Say why in at least 3 characters.

verRemove.title: Delete draft version {version}?
verRemove.intro: The draft and its lines are deleted. This cannot be undone.
verRemove.introWaiting: The draft and its lines are deleted and its approval request is withdrawn. This cannot be undone.

verNotice.made: The new version was written as a draft.
verNotice.targetKept: The target is kept on version {version}.

verCmp.title: Compare two versions
verCmp.notComparable: The versions are in different currencies ({a} and {b}): their figures are not compared.
verCmp.noGrain: Costs are not in your role: the lines show what changed in quantity only.

goal.title: Target price
goal.intro: Type a target price or margin for version {version} and see the cost it allows and which lines would have to change.
goal.noVersionBody: Write a cost sheet version first: the target is worked out on a version.
goal.keepSame: The version has this target already.
goal.ask: Type a target and work it out.

col.cutShared: Its part of a shared cut

goal.linesNote: Lines worked out as a percent of others follow them: the cuts shown are a little more than enough.
goal.heldBoth: Prices and margins are not in your role: the version's own target is not used.
goal.heldPrice: Prices are not in your role: only a target margin can be typed.
goal.heldMargin: Margins are not in your role: only a target price can be typed.

goalBasis.WEIGHTED: Weighted cost for the size mix

hint.WEIGHTED: What a typical order of the size mix costs per garment; the base size's cost when the version keeps no size mix.

goalState.NO_COST: The version misses an input at this basis: nothing is worked out from it.
goalState.NO_TARGET: Type a target price, a target margin or both.
goalState.WITHIN: Within the allowed cost: no line has to change.
goalState.ABOVE: Above the allowed cost: the lines below must come down by the gap.
goalState.PRICE_ONLY: With a price alone: the margin it earns on this cost.
goalState.MARGIN_ONLY: With a margin alone: the price that earns it on this cost.

bysize.title: Cost by size and size surcharges
bysize.intro: How version {version}'s cost grows across the range, and the price surcharge that keeps its target margin for a size at least {pct} % above the base size.
bysize.noVersionBody: Write a cost sheet version first: the cost by size is read from a version.
bysize.failed: Couldn't read the cost by size
bysize.useLabel: Use the suggested surcharge for size {size}
bysize.noneBig: No size is {pct} % or more above the base size: no surcharge is suggested.
bysize.weighted: Weighted cost for the size mix: {amount}.
bysize.noGrain: Costs and prices are not in your role.
bysize.heldRight: Not in your role: price lists need pricelists.manage.
bysize.heldGrain: Prices are not in your role.
bysize.heldNoTarget: The version has no target margin: keep one under Target price first.
bysize.heldSame: The style has this surcharge already.
bysize.used: Size {size}'s surcharge is set on the style.

mass.title: Mass cost update
mass.pricesIntro: Give one or more materials a new standard price: every cost sheet that uses them gets a new draft version, and you see the effect on price lists and open orders before anything changes.
mass.findHint: Code or name, at least 2 characters.
mass.noMaterials: Finding materials is not in your role (product.materials.view).
mass.noRowsBody: Find a material above and add it.

count.documentsValue: {lists} price list entries · {lines} open order lines

mass.truncated: More documents are affected than shown here.
mass.noSeries: No cost sheet uses these materials.
mass.withoutSheet_one: {count} revision uses them but has no cost sheet: its effect is not worked out
mass.withoutSheet_other: {count} revisions use them but have no cost sheet: their effect is not worked out
mass.noLists: No active price list entry is affected.
mass.noOrders: No open order line is affected.
mass.noMargin: Margins are not in your role: their columns are not drawn.
mass.leaveOut_one: Leave the missing inputs out for the {count} series that misses them
mass.leaveOut_other: Leave the missing inputs out for the {count} series that miss them
mass.leaveOutHint: Their new drafts list what was left out; each can be approved only when typed lines cover it.
mass.noteHint: Optional: kept with the new prices and on each new draft.
mass.whatHappens: Approve update asks for a fresh code, writes the new prices, and makes a new draft version for each series. No approved version, posted cost or document changes.
mass.done: New prices written: {prices}. New draft versions: {drafts}.
mass.next: Each new draft goes for approval from its style's Cost tab.

held.noGrain: Costs are not in your role: the mass cost update needs costing.view and the cost grain (money.cost).
held.tooMany: At most {max} materials in one update.
held.busy: Wait for the step in progress.
held.noApply: Not in your role: applying needs costing.massUpdate.apply.
held.nothing: Nothing uses these materials: there is nothing to update.
held.incomplete_one: {count} series misses inputs: tick to leave them out, or fill them in first.
held.incomplete_other: {count} series miss inputs: tick to leave them out, or fill them in first.

problem.price: Type a figure above 0, with at most 6 decimals.
problem.unavailable: The factory can't be reached. Try again in a moment.
problem.stepUp: A fresh authenticator code is needed.
problem.invalid: A value was refused. Look at the prices and try again.
problem.moved: Something changed meanwhile. Show the effect again.
problem.search: Couldn't search the materials. Try again.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.sentence: Approving a mass cost update writes new standard prices and asks for a fresh code.

massRefusal.STALE: Something changed since you looked (a price, a version or a document): here is the effect again. Check it and approve again.
massRefusal.TOO_MANY: Too many cost sheets or documents for one update: split it.
massRefusal.NOTHING_CHANGES: Every new price is the price now.
massRefusal.NOT_RECOMPUTED: Some series miss inputs: tick to leave them out, or fill them in first.
massRefusal.NO_RIGHT: A material or a cost sheet belongs to a company where you may not change it.

cpm.title: Cost per minute and overhead
cpm.noRight: Not in your role: costing needs costing.view.
cpm.explain: The cost-per-minute calculator: a department's labour for a period ÷ its available minutes + overhead. Applied, it becomes the department's labour rate from a day on, and cost sheets read it.
cpm.accountant: Waits for the accountant: the overhead in a rate and the overhead rules are not confirmed yet.
cpm.noGrain: Costs are not in your role: the figures are not drawn.
cpm.emptyBody: Work out a department's cost per minute from its payroll and its minutes.
cpm.newIntro: Pick the department and the months, read its minutes, then type its labour total for the period.
cpm.centreHint: Optional: one work centre of the department.
cpm.minutesFrom: The working calendars × the planned seats: never a headcount.
cpm.overheadRules: Overhead a minute from the rules
cpm.overheadRulesHint_one: {count} rule a minute in force: the cost sheet adds it.
cpm.overheadRulesHint_other: {count} rules a minute in force: the cost sheet adds them.
cpm.noCentres: The department has no active work centre: type the minutes yourself.
cpm.directHint: The department's payroll total, never one person's.
cpm.minutesHint: Read them above, or type your own.
cpm.twice: Overhead rules a minute are in force for this department: overhead in the rate would be counted twice on the cost sheet.
cpm.resultWaits: Type the labour total and the minutes
cpm.resultHow: Labour ÷ minutes + indirect + overhead, rounded to 6 decimals.
cpm.applyIntro: {rate} a minute becomes the department's labour rate from the day below. Cost sheets written from that day read it.
cpm.validFromHint: Today or later: a past day would price work already costed.
cpm.efficiencyHint: Optional: else the department's rate in force, else 100.
cpm.removeIntro: The calculation is deleted. It was never applied, so no rate changes.

held.noManage: Not in your role: labour rates need costing.rates.manage.
held.noGrain: Costs are not in your role: a labour total is a cost.
held.busy: Wait for the change in progress.
held.applied: Already applied: a new figure is a new calculation.

problem.period: Pick the months: the last one may not be before the first.
problem.figure: Type 0 or more, with at most 6 decimals.
problem.minutes: Type more than 0 minutes, with at most 4 decimals.
problem.efficiency: Type a percent above 0, with at most 4 decimals.
problem.moved: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again.
problem.invalid: A value was refused. Look at the fields and try again.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more.
problem.unavailable: The factory can't be reached. Try again in a moment.
problem.read: The factory can't be reached. Try again in a moment.

notice.kept: The calculation is kept. Apply it to make it the department's rate.
notice.applied: Applied: the department's labour rate from {from}.

cpmRefusal.APPLIED: It is applied already: a new figure is a new calculation.
cpmRefusal.ANOTHER_APPLIED: Another calculation of this department is applied from the same day.
cpmRefusal.PAST_DAY: Pick today or a later day: a past day would price work already costed.
cpmRefusal.CURRENCY: A calculation is in the company's currency only.
cpmRefusal.ONE_SEAT: The department is planned with one seat: its cost per minute would be one person's pay. Plan more seats, or calculate a larger department.
cpmRefusal.NOT_OF_KIND: That work centre is not of this department.
cpmRefusal.TOO_BIG: The cost per minute is too big: look at the labour total and the minutes.
cpmRefusal.DATABASE: Another change was made at the same time: look again.

ohr.title: Overhead rules
ohr.explain: How overhead is added on a cost sheet, per company and department, from a month on.
ohr.none: No overhead rule: cost sheets add the costing settings' percent on materials and labour.
